target.title: fix(ui): keep microphone input settings usable on narrow screens
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves Fixes an issue where users choosing a realtime voice microphone would get an unusable nested composer popover on narrow screens, with long permission guidance collapsing into a thin vertical column. ## Why This Change Was Made Moves microphone input selection into the existing Chat settings Voice section and removes the composer caret/popover. Opening settings only enumerates available inputs; the adjacent refresh action is the explicit permission-request path. ## User Impact Users can select and refresh their microphone alongside Voice, Model, and Sensitivity settings. The selected input still persists per gateway and is passed to capture as an exact `deviceId` constraint. Release note: Microphone input selection now lives under Chat settings > Voice and remains usable on mobile-width screens. ## Evidence - Exact head: `23da7f2611` - Focused state/render tests: `130 passed` - Browser E2E: `8 passed` - Responsive browser coverage: `55 passed` - Production Control UI build: passed (`1010` modules) - Formatting and `git diff --check`: passed - Independent behavior validation: `10/10` contract clauses passed - Fresh Codex autoreview: no findings, patch correct (`0.87` confidence) ### Visual proof Desktop Voice settings with a selected USB microphone: Mobile blocked-permission state contained inside the settings panel: Behavior addressed: Moves microphone input selection out of the narrow composer popover and into Chat settings > Voice. Real environment tested: Live local Control UI mock gateway in Chromium-compatible Chrome at desktop `1440x1000` and mobile `320x720` viewports. Exact steps or command run after this patch: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/chat-controls.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-realtime.test.ts`; `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner ui/src/e2e/browser-talk-start-stop.e2e.test.ts ui/src/e2e/chat-composer-redesign.e2e.test.ts`; `pnpm ui:build`; `pnpm format:check -- `. Evidence after fix: Desktop settings show the selected USB input in a full-width Voice row; mobile settings show the microphone control and blocked-permission callout fully contained within the panel. Opening settings made zero `getUserMedia` calls; explicit refresh made exactly one. Observed result after fix: Device selection persists, capture uses `{ audio: { deviceId: { exact: "usb" } } }`, and the composer exposes a single microphone action without a device caret. What was not tested: A physical microphone device and a real browser permission dialog were not exercised; media-device discovery, permission denial, selection persistence, and exact capture constraints were validated with deterministic browser mocks.
